pages.title: Clouded Leopard
pages.text: The clouded leopard ($(o)Neofelis nebulosa$()) lives in the forests of the Himalayan foothills, southern China and mainland Southeast Asia.$(br2)Its grey to tawny coat is marked with large, dark-edged "clouds", and it has short legs, broad paws and a long, thick tail.$(br2)For the size of its skull it has the longest canine teeth of any living cat, and it can climb down tree trunks head first.
